# bassoonplayer <img src="man/figures/logo.svg" align="right" height="139" alt="" />

Wraps the core functions of the
[BassoonTracker JavaScript](https://github.com/steffest/bassoontracker) by
[Steffest](https://www.stef.be/) in the form of HTML widgets. It allows
you to play 'mod' and 'xm' tracker files in R, or embed a player in
a [Shiny app](https://shiny.posit.co/).

## Installation

You can install the development version of bassoonplayer from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pepijn-devries/bassoonplayer")
```

## Example

The code below will open a small 'mod' Tracker player in the viewer.

```{r example, eval=FALSE}
library(bassoonplayer)
mod_file <- system.file("cyberrid", "cyberrid.mod", package = "bassoonplayer")
bassoonplayer(mod_file)
```
